landing.desc: I design and build beautiful, fast websites for local businesses in Germany and beyond salons, cafés, restaurants and more.

what_i_offer.desc: From a simple one-pager to a full multi page website with booking and contact forms. I build exactly what your business needs, nothing more.

services.seo_desc: Help customers find you on Google when they search locally.

about_landing.desc_1: I'm Musa, a freelance web designer and developer based in Lörrach. My background is in working directly with customers and businesses, which means I understand what your clients actually want to see when they land on your website.
about_landing.desc_2: I specialize in small local businesses: hair salons, cafés, restaurants, shops. Your customers just want to find you, see what you offer, and book or visit.
about_landing.list_1: Based in Lörrach — I know the local market
about_landing.list_2: I speak your language — Turkish, English and a little German
about_landing.list_3: You deal directly with me, no agency middlemen
about_landing.list_4: Fixed price, fast delivery, no hidden surprises
about_landing.quote: I build websites because I saw how many great local businesses were invisible online and I knew I could fix that.

about.desc: I'm Musa a freelance web designer and developer based in Lörrach, Germany. I build beautiful, fast websites for small local businesses. My background is working directly with customers, which means I know what your clients want to see when they land on your site.
about.quote: I built websites because I saw how many great local businesses were invisible online and I knew I could fix that.

my_story.desc_1: I spent years working in customer-facing roles across different industries from travel and sales to digital marketing at Meta campaigns in Berlin. One thing I kept noticing: great local businesses, but invisible online.
my_story.desc_2: I knew I could change that. So I studied fullstack web development, focused on React and started building websites for the businesses around me. Salons, cafés, restaurants and loyal shops finally got the online presence they deserve.
my_story.quote: I bring a unique perspective to web development years of direct customer experience, digital marketing at Meta campaigns, and hands-on frontend development.
my_story.list_1: Based in Lörrach — I know the local market and what works here
my_story.list_2: You deal directly with me, not to an account manager
my_story.list_3: Background to customer service means I understand your clients
my_story.list_4: Fixed pricing, fast delivery, zero hidden expenses

contact.desc: Have a project in mind? Want to get your business online? Just want to ask a question? I'd love to hear from you. No pressure, no commitment, just a friendly conversation.
contact.location_serving: Serving the Basel-Lörrach region and beyond
contact.response_badge_desc: I reply to every message within 24 hours — usually much faster.
contact.q1_title: How long does it take to build a website?
contact.q1_desc: Most projects are completed in 2–3 weeks from our first call to launch. More complex sites can take a little longer.
contact.q2_title: Do I need to prepare anything before contacting you?
contact.q2_desc: Not at all. Just a rough idea of what your business does and what you'd like your website to achieve. We'll figure out the rest together.
contact.q3_title: What happens after the website is launched?
contact.q3_desc: I'm available for questions and small updates after launch. For ongoing changes, I offer a monthly maintenance package.
contact.q4_title: Can you work with Turkish-speaking clients?
contact.q4_desc: Absolutely I'm a native Turkish speaker and work with clients in Turkish, English and German.
